selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
selected_evidence.summary: The exact versionlock is persisted. DNF sees curl 8.12.1-6.el10 when the plugin is disabled, but reports “Nothing to do” with the lock active; curl remains 8.12.1-4.el10 before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 remained installed and running throughout the task and reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3; reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned running with boot ID d9a7cf8f-eee8-4f54-97e0-a5781c6d7207; curl, its lock, OS release, and kernel all recovered and were directly revalidated.
